job_post.responsible:
Content planning and publishing

  • Maintain a rolling editorial calendar covering social posts, articles, newsletters and company announcements.
  • Turn rough notes, interviews and leadership ideas into clear, audience-focused copy.
  • Coordinate approvals, assets and deadlines; keep stakeholders informed and follow through to publication.

Social media and distribution

  • Prepare, adapt and publish content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and X.
  • Repurpose articles and company updates into platform-appropriate posts and short-form content.
  • Help leadership maintain an active professional presence, using an agreed approval process.
  • Monitor comments and inquiries, escalating support and product questions to the appropriate team.

Newsletters and marketing materials

  • Draft and coordinate newsletters, customer communications and launch updates.
  • Support presentation decks, partner materials, product explainers and short promotional video scripts, including introductions for online presentations.
  • Brief designers and video editors, organize feedback and review final assets for consistency and clarity.

AI-assisted workflows and reporting

  • Use AI tools responsibly for research, first drafts, content repurposing and workflow efficiency.
  • Edit and fact-check outputs; preserve a natural brand voice and avoid unsupported claims.
  • Maintain an organized library of approved copy and creative assets.
  • Report on publishing consistency, engagement and relevant inquiries, with practical recommendations.
job_post.description: This role is about reliable execution, strong writing and initiative, not simply proposing campaigns. You will work within Company’s delivery team, coordinating for client direction and approvals rather than being expected to perform every specialist function yourself.
job_post.requirement:
• Ideally 2–4 years of relevant content, social media or digital marketing experience; a strong portfolio matters more than a specific degree.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with demonstrated ability to write clear, professional content for an international audience.
  • Organized and proactive: able to manage a publishing schedule and multiple deliverables without daily reminders.
  • Comfortable working with company leadership, designers and technical teams.
  • Practical experience with social publishing, email-marketing and basic reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with Canva or equivalent tools for simple adaptations; advanced design is not required.
  • Good judgment about approvals, confidentiality, accuracy and customer-facing financial-service claims.
job_post.employee_benefit: French or Spanish; GoHighLevel; basic video editing; fintech or international-services experience; SEO/content distribution; practical AI workflow experience.
